metrics.label: Valid independent reviews
metrics.counting_rule: Count issue-form submissions that name a concrete artifact, version or claim, provide evidence or method, and state a boundary or failure condition.
metrics.not_counted: Agreement, praise, popularity, sponsorship interest, or repeated comments from the same reviewer without new evidence.

metrics.label: Real non-commercial use reports
metrics.counting_rule: Count reports that identify a version or artifact and describe a real learning, education, public-benefit review, independent research, compatibility exploration, or criticism use.
metrics.not_counted: Stars, views, likes, reposts, vague interest, commercial production deployment, or private data that cannot be evaluated.

metrics.label: Sponsorship or commercial licensing inquiries
metrics.counting_rule: Count concrete resource-support, reciprocal-agreement, infrastructure sponsorship, or commercial licensing inquiries that identify a scope or resource question.
metrics.not_counted: Friendly comments, oral encouragement, vague support, payment-link requests, or attempts to buy governance, merge, evidence, conclusion, or validator privileges.

metrics.label: Explicit resource commitments
metrics.counting_rule: Count only written commitments that specify a resource class, scope, or next verification step without asking for factual, governance, or merge control in return.
metrics.not_counted: Oral support, preference statements, vague intent, praise, or contingent offers that require suppression of criticism or governance control.

metrics.label: Invalid, spam, or conflict signals
metrics.counting_rule: Count submissions that are spam, duplicate without information gain, request private data, request payment credentials, collapse evidence categories, or seek governance-for-support exchange.
metrics.not_counted: Good-faith critical reports that expose a real gap.

metrics.label: Maintainer burden
metrics.counting_rule: Record review load, triage time, emotional pressure, moderation burden, and follow-up cost created by the pilot.
metrics.not_counted: Popularity metrics or speculative future support.

signal_boundaries: The same org or individual posting multiple comments is not counted as multiple independent reviewers unless there is new evidence or a distinct method.
Oral support is not counted as a resource commitment.
Stars, views, likes, reposts, and friendly comments do not replace real use, independent review, or funding/legal commitment.
Sponsorship or commercial inquiry is not evidence that project claims are true.
Non-commercial use is not independent review unless it includes a reproducible review method and evidence boundary.
claim_ceiling: This plan establishes an observation interface for future external signals. It does not claim that any external recognition, funding willingness, production adoption, or independent validation already exists.
